# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.90

This release adds repeatable jobs so players can work around town, help NPCs,
and earn coins.

## New jobs and places

- Added Shopkeeper shifts at Buddy Market.
- Added Restaurant shifts at Sunny Bites.
- Added Delivery shifts at Buddy Delivery.
- Added Farming shifts at Sunshine Farm.
- Added all four workplaces to the town map with direct travel.
- Added a spacious, deterministic work district that streams with the
  surrounding procedural world.

## Tasks, rewards, and NPCs

- Each job has three ordered tasks and a clearly displayed coin wage.
- Managers explain the current task, customers and helpers react to progress,
  and completed shifts can be replayed.
- First-time job quests grant bonus rewards while later shifts continue to pay
  the normal wage.
- Career records persist completed shifts and total job earnings.
- Active shifts prevent conflicting travel and mini-games until the shift is
  completed or cancelled.

## Regression coverage

- Added job-state tests for task order, repeatable wages, cancellation, and
  saved career records.
- Added economy tests that verify every job pays exactly once per completed
  shift and does not repeat first-time quest bonuses.
- Added map, streamed-feature, tile-grid, quest-route, menu, and jobs-panel
  coverage.
- Kept the all-quest instruction test fast as the daily quest list grows.
- Completed phone-sized gameplay QA from workplace travel through the final
  customer interaction and confirmed the correct coin increase.

## Android updates

- Uses the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Retains the exact v1.5.79 update-signing identity so existing installations
  can update normally.
